info.title: Quiva Agents API
info.description: API for managing Quiva Agents. Every endpoint requires a Bearer JWT — the service derives the user/account from token claims; an API key alone is resolved by the gateway but is insufficient for these handlers. Corrected against the hub-service engine (see per-field notes).

post.description: Cancels one or more agents that were registered with the cancel_token. Use this to terminate running agent executions gracefully.

400.description: Bad request - check that cancel_token is provided and valid.

500.description: Server error - the cancellation request could not be processed.

post.description: Invokes an AI agent with specified configuration and prompt. Use this to execute agents with inline definitions or reference pre-configured agents by agent subject.

parameters.name: x-cancel-id
parameters.description: Cancel identifier for this agent invocation. NOTE: hub-service does NOT read this query param (nor the request-body cancel_token) — cancellation is an agent-service concern reached via POST /hub/agent/cancel. Kept for gateway/agent-service compatibility.

agent.name: data-analyzer
agent.behaviour: You are a data analysis expert

400.description: Bad request - check that prompt is provided and either agent or agent_subject is specified.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - wait before retrying.

500.description: Server error - the agent invocation could not be processed.

Agent.summary: Create an agent (body is wrapped in `config`)

config.name: Email Draft
config.description: Draft a reply to my email
config.behaviour: Draft a concise reply to the email.

get.description: Retrieves a specific agent by subject

put.description: Updates an existing agent agent's properties

delete.description: Deletes an agent by {id} (or subject in the body). Genuinely removes it — a second delete returns 404 and it disappears from the list — but a subsequent GET returns a hollow config rather than 404 (see GetAgentResponse).

subject.description: Optional — the full agent subject. When omitted, the {id} path param identifies the agent. Update is a PUT that REPLACES the config (only owner/shared are carried over from the prior version), so send a complete config.

Server-generated identifier: ms.hub.config.agent.<uuid>, where <uuid> is an MD5 hash of the submitted config. Any subject/id you send is ignored. Re-creating an identical config returns 409 "agent exists:<subject>".

GetAgentResponse.description: NOTE: a deleted or never-existed subject does NOT return 404 — hub-service returns a hollow config with all-empty fields (name/llm_provider/model/owner = ""). Treat an all-empty config as "not found"; use GET /hub/agent (list) to confirm existence. Likely an engine bug.

AgentAgentInvokeRequest.description: Provide either `subject` (an existing agent) OR an inline `agent` definition — 400 if neither. `prompt` (string or object) is expected but not strictly enforced by the engine. The old example field `agent_subject` is NOT read — use `subject`.

agent.description: Inline agent definition - use this to define agent configuration directly in the request.

subject.description: Subject of agent agent to invoke - use this to reference a pre-configured agent.

prompt.description: The input prompt or query for the agent to process - can be string or structured object.

session_id.description: Session identifier for conversation continuity - omit for one-shot interactions.

cancel_token.description: NOTE: not read by hub-service on invoke (agent-service concern). Cancel via POST /hub/agent/cancel.

visibility.description: Visibility level for the invocation (user: private, team: shared).

knowledge.description: Additional knowledge sources for this specific invocation using URI schemes (kv://, obj://, str://, sid://, dta://).

response_subject.description: Bellerophon subject for async response publishing.

await.description: Whether to wait for synchronous response (true) or return immediately (false).

folder.description: Optional folder/space path to organise the resulting session.

llm_provider.description: Override the provider for this invocation (requires model).

model.description: Override the model for this invocation (requires llm_provider).

no_invoke.description: If true, persist the message but do not run the agent.

complete.description: Whether the agent has completed its task (true) or requires more interaction (false).

escalate.description: Whether the agent is requesting human intervention or admin escalation.

result.description: Agent response - structured according to OutputSchema if defined, otherwise free-form string.

thinking.description: Model's reasoning or thought process extracted from the response.

error.description: Error details if success is false.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings from provisioning or execution.

provider.description: LLM provider used for this invocation.

model.description: Model identifier used for this invocation.

cost.description: Estimated cost in USD for this invocation.

message_count.description: Total number of messages in the session conversation history.

token_usage.description: Current conversation context usage in tokens.

instruction_metadata.description: Metadata about instruction processing if instructions were provided.

ai_summary_metadata.description: Metadata about AI summarization if performed.

id.description: Optional human-facing label (alphanumeric, dashes, underscores). This is NOT the identifier and is not used for routing — the real identifier is the server-generated `subject`. The GET/PUT/DELETE path {id} is the uuid suffix of that subject, not this field.

name.description: Human-readable agent name. (e.g., 'Knowledge Researcher' or 'Claude Chat'). If a name already exists, there is no need to update it unless the purpose of the agent has completely changed

description.description: Agent description.Human-readable explanation of what the agent does and its purpose.

agent_type.description: Built-in agent type - empty for standard LLM agent, 'deep-research' for research workflow agent.

behaviour.description: System prompt defining agent behaviour - this may be augmented by internal prompts.
behaviour.example: You are a data analysis expert

llm_provider.description: LLM service provider. invoke accepts only "claude" or "anthropic"; any other value returns 400 "unsupported provider".

model.description: Model identifier from available Claude models: claude-haiku-4-5 (default), claude-sonnet-4, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-5, claude-opus-4-1

api_key.description: Secret key for the LLM provider API key. If none is provided, a system key will be used. Only accounts with a TEAM subscription are allowed to use their own key. This property will be ignored for other subscription types and a system key will be used.

output_schema.description: Response structure with field descriptions - helps the LLM understand expected output format.

has_tools.description: Whether this agent has access to external tools/functions.

knowledge.description: Knowledge sources using URI schemes: kv://bucket/document, obj://bucket/document, str://stream/start/end, sid://session_id, dta://data

tools.description: Available tools using URI schemes: mcp://integration, fun://function, bit://tool

tool_definitions.description: Full tool definitions for dynamic registration from MCP or other sources.

timeout.description: Maximum request duration in milliseconds before timeout.

context_limit.description: Maximum conversation context in tokens managed by workforce.

message_history_limit.description: Number of historical messages to retain in conversation.

smart_context.description: Enable intelligent context curation for token optimization.

ai_smart_context.description: Enable AI-powered context summarization using Claude.

ai_summary_threshold.description: Trigger AI summarization when context reaches this capacity ratio (0.5-0.95).

ai_summary_model.description: Model to use for AI-powered summarization.

preserve_most_recent.description: Number of recent messages to always keep unsummarized.

ai_prompt.description: Enable AI-powered prompt and behaviour enhancement using Claude Haiku.

instructions.description: Optional guidance instructions for response validation and refinement.

context_variables.description: Key-value pairs injected into agent system prompt. WARNING: Values are not sanitized and can enable prompt injection.

mcp_base_urls.description: Override base URLs for MCP servers indexed by server ID.

llm_config.description: Optional LLM configuration overrides for this agent.

agent_settings.description: Advanced agent configuration for memory, context, verification, and debugging.

allowed_agents.description: List of agents this agent may invoke - empty means no invocation permitted

invocation_depth.description: Current invocation depth - 0 for main agent and 1 for sub-agent

appearance.description: Visual appearance configuration for the agent

api_key_source.description: Source of the API key - 'personal' or 'system'

shared.description: Sharing state of the agent - 'private' (only owner), 'team' (team members), or 'public' (anyone).

subject.description: Unique identifier for the invocable agent

description.description: Human-readable description of the agent's purpose

AllowedAgent.description: Represents an agent that can be invoked by another agent. This enables richer metadata about permitted agents for dynamic tool documentation.

avatar.description: Whether to display an avatar for the agent

avatar_bg_size.description: Background size setting for the avatar

color.description: Color scheme for the agent's visual representation

fit_avatar.description: Whether to fit the avatar to its container

AgentAppearance.description: Visual appearance configuration for the agent

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the tool does.

schema.description: JSON Schema defining the tool's input parameters.

scheme_name.description: Security scheme name from OpenAPI specification.

private_auth.description: If true, the MCP auth has to be set per user, otherwise the auth is shared.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature override - higher values make output more random.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens override for model output.

max_turns.description: Maximum turn count for LLM conversations.

AgentSettings.description: Advanced agent configuration options for memory, context, verification, and debugging.

memory.description: Smart memory system configuration for learning from historical resolutions.

smart_context_advanced.description: Advanced smart context configuration for token management.

enabled.description: Enable smart memory system for learning from historical resolutions.

marker_types.description: Types of markers to capture in memory.

query_enabled.description: Enable querying memory bank for similar historical problems.

max_memory_entries.description: Maximum number of memory entries to retain.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score for memory retrieval (0.0-1.0).

token_limit_auto_adjust.description: Enable dynamic token allocation based on query complexity.

ephemeral_streams.description: Enable ephemeral streams for context-relevant message queuing.

min_messages_for_summary.description: Minimum messages before summarization is triggered.

consensus_runs.description: Number of runs for consensus (typically 3 or 5).

verifier_agent.description: Specific agent name to use for verification runs.

auto_escalate_on_error.description: Automatically escalate to human when errors occur.

confidence_score.description: Escalate when confidence drops below this threshold.

turn_count.description: Escalate after N turns without resolution.

enabled.description: Enable conversation branching for testing approaches.

auto_checkpoint.description: Automatically create checkpoints at critical points.

max_branches.description: Maximum number of active conversation branches.

debug_mode.description: Enable detailed debug logging and instrumentation.

capture_thinking.description: Capture and log LLM reasoning processes.

semantic_indexing.description: Enable semantic indexing with llms.txt-style summaries.

adaptive_image_resolution.description: Allow LLM to request higher resolution regions.

bucket_semantic_search.description: Enable semantic search across knowledge buckets.

max_retrieval_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to retrieve from knowledge sources.

retryable.description: Whether the request can be retried.

was_refined.description: Whether response was modified by instructions.

processing_time_ms.description: Time spent processing instructions in milliseconds.

original_tokens.description: Number of tokens in original messages.

processing_time_ms.description: Time spent on AI summarization in milliseconds.

fallback_used.description: Whether fallback truncation was used due to AI failure.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: API key authentication via X-Api-Key header.

agentID.name: id
agentID.description: Agent id - hash of the original agent definition
